name: Hilton Orrington/Evanston
welcomeMessage: Recommended by our front desk team — the spots we send friends and family to when they visit Evanston.

recs.name: La Cocinita
recs.shortDescription: A beloved Venezuelan spot known for fresh arepas, empanadas, and plantains, with plenty of gluten-free and vegan options. Recognized by Food Network and the Wall Street Journal.
recs.staffNote: This is my go-to spot I send people when they're looking for a casual but great meal. Their staff is incredible and I highly recommend the tostones.

recs.name: Joy Yee
recs.shortDescription: The Evanston go-to for pan-Asian food, huge portions, and famously massive smoothies — the mango lychee is unreal.
recs.staffNote: Get the beef cubes over tomato rice, you won't regret it.

recs.name: Colectivo Coffee
recs.shortDescription: A big, sunny roastery-cafe with great espresso and plenty of seating for working or catching up.

recs.name: Habibi Mediterranean Grill
recs.shortDescription: Fast-casual Mediterranean with generous portions — shawarma and falafel plates that punch well above their price.

recs.name: Bat 17
recs.shortDescription: A laid-back neighborhood sports bar with a deep beer list and pool tables — a good pick for a relaxed night out.

recs.name: Bookends & Beginnings
recs.shortDescription: An independent bookstore just down the street from the hotel — genuinely one of the best browsing experiences in Evanston.

recs.name: The Spice House
recs.shortDescription: Evanston-founded spice shop with fresh-ground blends — a great, packable gift for the foodies back home. It's up in the Central Street shopping area, a bit of a trip from downtown, but worth it.

recs.name: Insomnia Cookies
recs.shortDescription: Warm cookies delivered (or picked up) late — open well past midnight for exactly the craving you'd expect.
